api/src/routers/services.py.name: Supervised services
api/src/routers/services.py.description: Runs and watches the long-lived helper programs workflows depend on, starting them again if they stop.

api/src/routers/solutions.py.name: Packaged solutions
api/src/routers/solutions.py.description: Packages apps, forms, automations and settings so they can be installed elsewhere, kept in step with source control and updated.

api/src/routers/tables.py.name: Data tables
api/src/routers/tables.py.description: Stores the records apps and workflows read and write, with rules about who may see them.

api/src/routers/tools.py.name: Available tools
api/src/routers/tools.py.description: Lists every tool workflows and AI assistants can use, both built in and made by workflows.

api/src/routers/usage_reports.py.name: Usage reports
api/src/routers/usage_reports.py.description: Reports how much processing time and AI cost each workflow and run has used.

api/src/routers/users.py.name: Staff accounts
api/src/routers/users.py.description: Invites, updates and removes the people who use the platform, and shows what each of them can reach.

api/src/routers/version.py.name: Version details
api/src/routers/version.py.description: Reports which version of the platform is running so the app and companion tools can check they match.

api/src/routers/websocket.py.name: Live updates
api/src/routers/websocket.py.description: Keeps screens current by pushing run progress, notifications and other changes as they happen.

api/src/routers/workflow_keys.py.name: Automation keys
api/src/routers/workflow_keys.py.description: Issues and revokes the secret keys that let outside systems start an automation.

GET /api/services.name: Supervised services list
GET /api/services.description: Lists the helper programs the platform supervises and whether each is running.

GET /api/services/{service_id}.name: Service details
GET /api/services/{service_id}.description: Shows one service's settings and its current state.

PATCH /api/services/{service_id}.name: Change service policy
PATCH /api/services/{service_id}.description: Adjusts how a service is restarted, how many tries it gets and how long it waits between them.

POST /api/services/{service_id}/start.name: Start a service
POST /api/services/{service_id}/start.description: Asks for a service to run and clears anything that was blocking it.

POST /api/services/{service_id}/stop.name: Stop a service
POST /api/services/{service_id}/stop.description: Records that a service should be off, then shuts the running copy down.

POST /api/services/{service_id}/restart.name: Restart a service
POST /api/services/{service_id}/restart.description: Stops the running copy so a fresh one starts, without marking the service as off.

POST /api/services/{service_id}/enable.name: Enable a service
POST /api/services/{service_id}/enable.description: Allows a service to run again without starting it straight away.

POST /api/services/{service_id}/disable.name: Disable a service
POST /api/services/{service_id}/disable.description: Stops a service and blocks it from starting until it is enabled again.

GET /api/services/{service_id}/attempts.name: Service run history
GET /api/services/{service_id}/attempts.description: Lists each attempt to run a service, newest first, with how it ended.

GET /api/services/{service_id}/logs.name: Service output
GET /api/services/{service_id}/logs.description: Returns the most recent log lines from a service.

POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/dev-co.name: Start solution development
POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/dev-co.description: Gives a short-lived pass so a developer can work on one app inside a solution.

POST /api/solutions/import-workspace/pre.name: Preview a workspace upload
POST /api/solutions/import-workspace/pre.description: Reads an uploaded workspace package and reports what it would add or clash with.

POST /api/solutions/import-workspace.name: Import a workspace
POST /api/solutions/import-workspace.description: Loads an uploaded workspace package into the platform as a background task.

POST /api/solutions/import-workspace/pre.name: Preview from a repository
POST /api/solutions/import-workspace/pre.description: Reads a one-off snapshot from a code repository and reports what installing it would do.

POST /api/solutions.name: Create a solution
POST /api/solutions.description: Starts a new solution that will hold a packaged set of apps, automations and settings.

GET /api/solutions.name: Solutions list
GET /api/solutions.description: Lists the packaged solutions available in this workspace.

GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/sdk/sta.name: App building-block status
GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/sdk/sta.description: Reports which versions of the app building blocks each app in a solution uses.

POST /api/solutions/sdk/update.name: Refresh several solutions
POST /api/solutions/sdk/update.description: Rebuilds every app in the chosen solutions against the current building blocks.

POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/sdk/up.name: Refresh a solution's apps
POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/sdk/up.description: Rebuilds one solution's apps against the current building blocks.

GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}.name: Solution details
GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}.description: Shows one solution's settings, source and current status.

GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/logo.name: Solution icon
GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/logo.description: Returns the picture shown on the solution's catalog card.

GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/readme.name: Solution description
GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/readme.description: Returns the long description shown on the solution's page.

PUT /api/solutions/{solution_id}/readme.name: Edit solution description
PUT /api/solutions/{solution_id}/readme.description: Replaces the solution's long description, or clears it.

GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/setup.name: Solution setup checklist
GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/setup.description: Lists the settings a solution needs and whether each one has been filled in.

POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/export.name: Export a solution
POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/export.description: Builds a fresh package from everything the solution currently owns, ready to share.

POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/export.name: Start a backup export
POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/export.description: Queues a background task that packages the solution for backup.

GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/export-.name: Backup exports
GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/export-.description: Lists the backup exports made for a solution.

GET /api/solutions/export-jobs/{job_id}.name: Export progress
GET /api/solutions/export-jobs/{job_id}.description: Shows how a packaging task is going and where its file is.

POST /api/solutions/export-jobs/{job_id}.name: Get a download link
POST /api/solutions/export-jobs/{job_id}.description: Creates a temporary link for downloading a finished export.

GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/entitie.name: What a solution owns
GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/entitie.description: Lists everything a solution owns and which of its settings still need values.

GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/capture.name: Things to capture
GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/capture.description: Lists the existing apps, automations and settings that could be folded into a solution.

POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/captur.name: Preview a capture
POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/captur.description: Shows everything that would come along with the chosen items before capturing them.

PATCH /api/solutions/{solution_id}.name: Update a solution
PATCH /api/solutions/{solution_id}.description: Changes a solution's name, who it covers or how it connects to source control.

POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/uninst.name: Uninstall a solution
POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/uninst.description: Marks a solution as no longer in use without deleting what it created.

GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/deletio.name: What deletion would remove
GET /api/solutions/{solution_id}/deletio.description: Counts everything that would be destroyed before a solution is deleted for good.

DELETE /api/solutions/{solution_id}.name: Delete a solution
DELETE /api/solutions/{solution_id}.description: Permanently deletes a solution and everything it created, once confirmed.

POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/deploy.name: Deploy a solution
POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/deploy.description: Puts the solution's latest content live and updates what it installed.

GET /api/solutions/deploy-jobs/{job_id}.name: Deployment progress
GET /api/solutions/deploy-jobs/{job_id}.description: Shows how a deployment is going and any errors so far.

POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/captur.name: Capture into a solution
POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/captur.description: Adopts existing apps, automations and settings into a solution without moving them.

POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/pull/a.name: Confirm pulled changes
POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/pull/a.description: Clears the list of changes already brought in from source control.

POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/sync.name: Sync from source control
POST /api/solutions/{solution_id}/sync.description: Queues a refresh that brings in the latest changes from the connected repository.

POST /api/solutions/install/preview.name: Preview installing a package
POST /api/solutions/install/preview.description: Reads a solution package and reports what installing it would create.

POST /api/solutions/install/preview-repo.name: Preview installing from a repository
POST /api/solutions/install/preview-repo.description: Clones a repository and reports what installing the solution there would create.

POST /api/solutions/install/from-repo.name: Install from a repository
POST /api/solutions/install/from-repo.description: Creates a source-controlled solution install and starts its first deployment.

POST /api/solutions/install.name: Install a solution
POST /api/solutions/install.description: Starts installing a solution package as a background task.

POST /api/tables.name: Create a table
POST /api/tables.description: Creates a new table for storing records used by apps and automations.

GET /api/tables.name: Tables list
GET /api/tables.description: Lists the tables the signed-in person is allowed to see.

POST /api/tables/policies/validate.name: Check table rules
POST /api/tables/policies/validate.description: Checks a proposed set of access rules for a table before they are saved.

GET /api/tables/{table_id}.name: Table details
GET /api/tables/{table_id}.description: Shows one table's settings and which client its records belong to.

PATCH /api/tables/{table_id}.name: Update a table
PATCH /api/tables/{table_id}.description: Changes a table's name, description or access rules.

DELETE /api/tables/{table_id}.name: Delete a table
DELETE /api/tables/{table_id}.description: Deletes a table and every record in it.

POST /api/tables/{table_id}/documents.name: Add a record
POST /api/tables/{table_id}/documents.description: Stores a new record in the table.

POST /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/up.name: Save a record
POST /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/up.description: Adds a record, or replaces the existing one with the same identity, in one step.

GET /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/cou.name: Count records
GET /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/cou.description: Counts how many records a table holds.

GET /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/{do.name: Read a record
GET /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/{do.description: Returns one record from the table.

PATCH /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/{.name: Update a record
PATCH /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/{.description: Changes some fields of a record and leaves the rest as they were.

DELETE /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/.name: Delete a record
DELETE /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/.description: Removes one record from the table.

POST /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/qu.name: Search a table
POST /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/qu.description: Finds records matching filters, with paging and sorting.

POST /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/ba.name: Save many records
POST /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/ba.description: Adds or updates a batch of records in a single step.

POST /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/ba.name: Delete many records
POST /api/tables/{table_id}/documents/ba.description: Removes a batch of records by their identities.

GET /api/tools.name: All available tools
GET /api/tools.description: Lists every tool a workflow or AI assistant can call, built in and workflow-made.

GET /api/tools/system.name: Built-in tools
GET /api/tools/system.description: Lists the tools the platform provides out of the box.

GET /api/reports/usage.name: Usage report
GET /api/reports/usage.description: Shows run counts, processing time and AI cost over a chosen period.

GET /api/reports/workflow-resources.name: Cost per run
GET /api/reports/workflow-resources.description: Shows processing time and AI cost for each run or each automation.

GET /api/users.name: Staff list
GET /api/users.description: Lists the people who can sign in, with their status and roles.

POST /api/users.name: Invite a person
POST /api/users.description: Creates an account and sends the person a sign-in invitation.

PATCH /api/users/bulk.name: Change several people
PATCH /api/users/bulk.description: Applies one change, such as a status or role, to many people at once.

POST /api/users/{user_id}/invite/send.name: Send an invitation
POST /api/users/{user_id}/invite/send.description: Sends a fresh sign-in invitation to a person.

POST /api/users/{user_id}/invite/regener.name: Replace an invitation
POST /api/users/{user_id}/invite/regener.description: Issues a new invitation link and cancels the previous one.

DELETE /api/users/{user_id}/invite.name: Cancel an invitation
DELETE /api/users/{user_id}/invite.description: Withdraws a pending invitation so it can no longer be used.

GET /api/users/{user_id}.name: Person details
GET /api/users/{user_id}.description: Shows one person's account details and access.

PATCH /api/users/{user_id}.name: Update a person
PATCH /api/users/{user_id}.description: Changes a person's name, contact details or account status.

POST /api/users/{user_id}/mfa/reset.name: Reset someone's extra step
POST /api/users/{user_id}/mfa/reset.description: Clears a person's two-step sign-in so they can set it up again.

GET /api/users/{user_id}/roles.name: A person's roles
GET /api/users/{user_id}/roles.description: Lists the roles assigned to one person.

GET /api/users/{user_id}/forms.name: Forms a person can open
GET /api/users/{user_id}/forms.description: Lists the forms one person is allowed to use.

GET /api/users/{user_id}/role-assignment.name: Where a person has roles
GET /api/users/{user_id}/role-assignment.description: Shows which role applies to a person in each client organization.

GET /api/users/{user_id}/access.name: What a person can reach
GET /api/users/{user_id}/access.description: Summarises everything one person is allowed to see and do.

PUT /api/users/{user_id}/role-assignment.name: Set a person's roles
PUT /api/users/{user_id}/role-assignment.description: Replaces which roles a person holds in each client organization.

POST /api/users/{user_id}/access/check.name: Check a permission
POST /api/users/{user_id}/access/check.description: Answers whether a person may perform a particular action in a particular place.

GET /api/version.name: Version details
GET /api/version.description: Reports which version is running so the app and companion tools can check they match.

WEBSOCKET /ws/connect.name: Live update connection
WEBSOCKET /ws/connect.description: Opens a live link so screens receive run progress and notices the moment they happen.

WEBSOCKET /ws/execution/{execution_id}.name: Follow one run live
WEBSOCKET /ws/execution/{execution_id}.description: Streams the progress and output of a single run as it happens.

GET /api/workflow-keys.name: Automations with keys
GET /api/workflow-keys.description: Lists the automations that outside systems can start with a key.

POST /api/workflow-keys.name: Issue an automation key
POST /api/workflow-keys.description: Creates a secret key that lets an outside system start an automation; shown only once.

DELETE /api/workflow-keys/{workflow_id}.name: Revoke an automation key
DELETE /api/workflow-keys/{workflow_id}.description: Disables an automation's key so outside systems can no longer start it.
